title: Chinese Chicken Skewers with Irish Spice
description: Grilled chicken skewers with an Irish twist, marinated in a flavorful Chinese-inspired sauce.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger, and black pepper. Blend until smooth.
Add Irish whiskey to the marinade and blend until well combined.
Add chicken to the marinade and mix until coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
Serve hot with additional marinade as a dipping sauce, if desired.
